rule: exactly these three scenarios (no grid); same execution model, fee schedule, stale policy and data-quality policy; they differ only in latency and slippage. Arithmetic identical to scenarios_v1 (v1 file unchanged); v2 fixes purpose, specification and provenance. Defined before any outcome; never chosen or tuned on returns, P&L or Paper outcomes

scenarios.purpose_text: a lower-bound cost reference; NEVER a realistic fill

spec.reference_price: decision mid at T (analytic) and touch at T (executable reference)
spec.spread: observed at T: buy pays the ask, sell receives the bid (MEASURED touch, DERIVED spread cost)
spec.fee: 10 bps taker per side (ASSUMED, generic public standard tier)
spec.depth_treatment: NOT used: no displayed-depth check, so an order larger than displayed depth is still priced at the touch (this is why it is only a lower bound)
spec.failure_refusal: book INVALID (no state, downtime, previous run, too stale, stream missing / not observing, crossed or locked, non-positive) -> fill and every cost UNAVAILABLE with a reason; no fallback
spec.provenance: touch MEASURED; spread cost DERIVED; fee ASSUMED; slippage ASSUMED; total cost ASSUMED (weakest)

scenarios.purpose_text: the primary scenario for future gross-to-net evaluation; every unmeasured component is ASSUMED and labelled so; it is not 'realistic' or 'measured'

spec.latency: 1000 ms (ASSUMED research sensitivity value; resolved only to the stream cadence)
spec.reference_price: decision mid at T; executable touch at T + 1 s
spec.depth_treatment: displayed-depth walk of the PIT depth snapshot at T + 1 s for the order notional (50 USDT default input; never optimized)
spec.slippage: X1-S2 depth walk relative to the snapshot's own level 1 (ESTIMATED; displayed-liquidity lower bound)
spec.stale_policy: book and depth rules of X1-STALE-POLICY (POLICY, ASSUMED)
spec.failure_refusal: book INVALID -> UNAVAILABLE; depth INVALID, invalid / crossed ladder or notional above displayed depth -> UNAVAILABLE (REFUSED, counted in coverage); never replaced by the touch or any fallback; depth_book_inconsistent and depth_incomplete flagged
spec.provenance: touch MEASURED; spread cost DERIVED; slippage ESTIMATED; fee ASSUMED; latency ASSUMED; total cost ASSUMED (weakest)

scenarios.purpose_text: a sensitivity test, NOT a prediction and not a worst case

spec.reference_price: decision mid at T; executable touch at T + 5 s
spec.depth_treatment: displayed-depth walk at T + 5 s, as EXEC-BASE
spec.slippage: depth walk (ESTIMATED) PLUS a fixed 10 bps per side add-on (ASSUMED sensitivity, POLICY_OR_LITERATURE_INSPIRED)
spec.provenance: slippage ASSUMED (weakest of ESTIMATED walk and ASSUMED add-on); total cost ASSUMED

latency_is_not_a_cost: latency changes WHICH state is met (reported as latency_drift_bps, market movement); it is never added to cost
sensitivity_table: X1-S1-ZERO / LOW / MODERATE / SEVERE (0 / 5 / 10 / 25 bps per side) may be reported next to a scenario; they are ASSUMED sensitivity values, not additional scenarios
reporting_rule: a future evaluation reports all three scenarios side by side with their coverage; a result is never presented under one scenario alone, and EXEC-IDEALIZED is never presented as achievable
